Home.title: PURE EVIL STORE
Home.description: A store for all your evil needs.
Home.outerwearSubtitle: Technical cowls, modular shells, knit drapes
Home.apparelSubtitle: Heavyweight fleece, raw edges, spine sigils
Home.manifestoDocDesc: Every garment is a ritual. Cut sharp, dyed in obsidian, marked with the sigil. Worn by those who refuse the ordinary.
Home.manifestoMatDesc: Heavyweight Japanese fleece, raw-edge construction, oxidised hardware. Built to outlast the trends that fear it.
Home.manifestoCodeDesc: Discipline builds freedom. Restraint becomes power.
Home.taglineDark: We do not chase the light — we master the dark.
Home.taglineLight: We do not fear the light — we sculpt the form.
Home.sizingDesc: The Relic runs boxy and cropped. Order true to size for the oversized fit, or size down for a modern boxy cut. Model wears M.
Home.faq1A: Cut and sewn in Porto from 280 gsm cotton, then hand screen-printed in Berlin. Each tee is garment-dyed after printing — imperfections are intentional.
Home.faq2A: Boxy, oversized, drop-shoulder. If you're between sizes and want a modern boxy fit, size down. For a true oversized drape, size up.
Home.faq3A: Orders ship within 3 business days from our Berlin studio. International delivery in 5–10 business days via tracked courier.
Home.cultDesc: First access to every drop. Encrypted ritual updates. Exclusive sigils never sold to the masses. Initiation is permanent.
Home.cultDisclaimer: No mercy. No spam. Unsubscribe to renounce.

void-hoodie.name: VOID HOODIE
void-hoodie.desc: Heavyweight Japanese loopback fleece, garment-dyed in true obsidian. Raw-cut hem, oversized monastic hood, and the sigil screen-printed in matte oxblood across the spine. Cut for ritual, built for the obsessed.

ascension-parka.name: ASCENSION PARKA
ascension-parka.desc: Technical gothic parka with modular high-neck cowl, fully taped seams, magnetic pocket flaps, and oxidised custom hardware.

ritual-cloak.name: RITUAL CLOAK
ritual-cloak.desc: Knitted long cloak in superfine merino wool. Dramatic asymmetric hem, raw-edge cowl hood, integrated thumbholes, and dual concealed internal drop pockets.

eclipse-bomber.name: ECLIPSE BOMBER
eclipse-bomber.desc: Classic flight silhouette reworked in industrial obsidian satin. Features high-density matte crest chest embroidery, heavy rib trim, and blood-red quilted lining.

obsidian-cargo.name: OBSIDIAN CARGO
obsidian-cargo.desc: Reinforced triple-weave cotton canvas cargo trousers. Features 10-pocket modular system, articulated knees, adjustable ankle straps, and distressed steel D-ring details.

slashed-longsleeve.name: SLASHED LONGSLEEVE
slashed-longsleeve.desc: Technical long sleeve shirt with slashed detailing.

shadow-cargo.name: SHADOW CARGO PANTS
shadow-cargo.desc: Obsidian cargo pants with custom D-rings.
